title: Molecular and ALD-Based Interface Engineering
question: How do molecular contacts and ALD-grown electrodes change charge extraction across device platforms?
role: First author on both related papers
mechanism: SAM dipoles tune electrode work function and hole extraction; a separate ALD study develops laminated In₂O₃:V₂O₅ electrode stacks.
approach: Study these interface strategies separately in organic photovoltaics and capacitor devices.
evidence: Published device studies of SAM-treated contacts and ALD-processed laminated electrodes.
achievement: Two first-author papers connect interface design with photovoltaic and capacitor operation.
myContribution: First author on both published papers.
outcome: The two studies establish complementary molecular and oxide-electrode routes for controlling thin-film device interfaces.
